text: Every fill prints two labels: the prescription label for the medicine, and a bag label for the check.
Juniper's thyroid tablets are ready to fill.
Type your notes for the checker first. They print on the bag label.
Then print the Rx and bag labels.
Check the directions, refills and doctor before printing.
With the DYMO plugged in, Print on DYMO prints both labels, one after the other.
No DYMO? Use the system print dialog. It prints the same two labels.
The first is the prescription label. It goes on the medicine.
The second is the bag label: the order number, client, pet, the pet’s weight when we have one, and your notes.
Set the bag label in front of the filled medicine and the stock bottle, so the checker can compare them.
Bag label only reprints just the bag label.
The most common mistakes: printing before typing the checker notes, and sticking the bag label on the medicine.
Remember: notes first, then print. Rx label on the medicine, bag label in front of it for the check.
